_how_to_read: LIFE-618: the one list of job sources. One object per source: name (the stage: python -m lifeos.run <name>), module, function (default run), floor (raise a smaller --limit to this), tick (the Jobs-tick step: budget, limit, bulk, group, providers; leave out when the source does not run in the tick) with after (the tick step it follows), and codes ({CODE: [class, counts as an attempt, meaning, action]}) for its own outcome codes, partial_failure (a code: a run whose counts carry failed > 0 exits 1 with it). Data, not code, so no layer imports another (D17).
status_how_to_read: LIFE-907 (Nov 22 2026): one word per stage, set against the code and the workflows, never by a guess. active = a scheduled workflow or the Jobs tick runs it; parked = it is wired but does no work (a switch is off or nothing feeds it); manual = only a dispatch input or a person runs it; retired = removed from use. The loader reads only `sources`, so this key never changes a run; tests/contracts/test_source_registry.py keeps it complete.

status_notes.boards-tick: A tick step that does nothing while the BOARDS_IN_TICK switch is off (lifeos/platform/switches.json, state off): the four windows own the boards (LIFE-905).
status_notes.boards-backfill: A tick step that does nothing while the BOARDS_BACKFILL switch is off (lifeos/platform/switches.json, state off).
status_notes.resolve-dice: Not a row in this file: a Jobs-tick step (lifeos/jobs/tick.py) that runs hourly with no input. No sender rule or source feeds Dice (SENDER_RULES holds only Lensa, Jobright and LinkedIn alerts; the dice row in us_remote.json is a discovery helper nothing reads). A feeder is a separate decision.
status_notes.board-check: Run by a dispatch input of hourly.yml, not by a schedule.
status_notes.boards-preview: Run by the report=boards-preview dispatch input of hourly.yml, not by a schedule.
status_notes.manual-job: manual-job.yml is dispatch-only; one job Jim names by hand.
status_notes.network-layout: Run by network.yml (dispatch only, stage layout); no schedule.
status_notes.network-match: Run by network.yml (dispatch only, stage match); no schedule.
status_notes.scale-up-register: Run by diag.yml (dispatch) only: a read-only report of the gov.uk register.
